# Little Green Backpack

> > A comprehensive backpacking and budget travel resource covering Europe, Asia, and beyond with city guides, metro navigation, food guides, and practical trip planning advice.

Little Green Backpack specializes in backpacking guides for major cities across Europe (Paris, Rome, Madrid, Vienna, Prague, Barcelona, London) and Asia (Bangkok), offering detailed information on public transportation, local cuisine, day trips, and budget-friendly travel tips. The site includes the Euro Trip Kit resource and focuses on helping travelers plan affordable, authentic experiences.

## Key Topics

- Backpacking Europe
- Budget Travel
- Trip Planning
- City Guides
- Metro & Public Transportation
- European Food Guides
- Paris Travel
- Rome & Vatican City
- Madrid & Spain
- Prague & Vienna
- Asia Backpacking
- 7-Day Itineraries
- Hostel Travel
- Euro Trip Kit

## City Guides Overview

- [City Guides - Backpacking Europe (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guides): Main hub for Europe city guides covering Rome, Spain, Greek isles & more
- [City Guides - Backpacking Asia (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guides/asia): Asia city guides hub covering Angkor Wat, Philippines & Asian destinations

## European City Guides

- [Paris Backpack Guide | How To Plan Your Trip To Paris (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/paris-travel-guide): Comprehensive Paris backpacking guide with Eiffel Tower, Louvre & French phrases
- [Prague Backpack Guide | How To Plan Your Trip To Prague (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/prague-travel-guide): Prague backpacking guide with Old Town Square, Astronomical Clock & Czech tips
- [Vienna Backpack Guide | How To Plan Your Trip To Vienna (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/vienna-travel-guide): Vienna backpacking guide with St. Stephen's Cathedral, Opera House & German
- [How To Backpack Madrid (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/destinations/how-to-backpack-madrid): Madrid backpacking guide with Spanish phrases, food & budget trip planning
- [How To Backpack London (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/destinations/how-to-backpack-london): London backpacking guide with British food, budget travel & trip planning
- [Vatican Visitors Guide (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/vatican-visitors-guide): Vatican City guide: St Peter's Basilica, Sistine Chapel & skip-line tickets

## Asian City Guides

- [How To Backpack Bangkok (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/destinations/how-to-backpack-bangkok): Bangkok backpacking guide with Thai phrases, budget travel & trip planning

- [Spanish Food Guide | 10 Things To Try While In Madrid (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/spanish-food-guide-madrid): Madrid Spanish food guide featuring tapas, paella & traditional dishes
- [8 French Desserts You Need To Try (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/8-french-desserts-you-need-to-try-paris): French desserts & pastries guide for Paris dining and cuisine experiences
- [10 Spanish Desserts You Need To Try (2026)](https://www.littlegreenbackpack.com/city-guide/10-spanish-desserts-you-need-to-try-barcelona): Spanish desserts guide: Crema Catalana, Flan, Churros con Chocolate in Spain

## Travel Tips & Resources
